scheme_name_original: Program Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional (JKN / BPJS Kesehatan)
scheme_name_english: National Health Insurance Program (JKN BPJS Kesehatan)
administrator: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial Kesehatan (BPJS Kesehatan)

membership_categories.label: Penerima Bantuan Iuran Jaminan Kesehatan (Subsidized vulnerable population paid by APBN/APBD)
Pekerja Penerima Upah (Formal employees in government, state-owned enterprises, and private companies)
Pekerja Bukan Penerima Upah / Peserta Mandiri (Self-employed and independent workers)
Bukan Pekerja (Investors, pensioners, and non-employed residents)

contribution_rules: PPU: 5% of monthly wage (4% employer, 1% employee, salary cap IDR 12,000,000). PBPU Mandiri: Flat monthly premium per member according to class (Kelas 1: IDR 150k, Kelas 2: IDR 100k, Kelas 3: IDR 35k).
benefit_summary: Comprehensive primary medical care at registered FKTP clinic (Puskesmas / Dokter Praktik / Klinik Pratama)
Specialist outpatient consultation and surgical inpatient hospital care at FKRTL with electronic referral
Emergency medical services at any hospital Emergency Department (IGD) without prior referral
Essential medicine coverage pursuant to Formularium Nasional (Fornas)
referral_requirements: Strict tiered referral system (Sistem Rujukan Berjenjang) through primary care clinic (FKTP). Direct hospital visits without emergency or referral are non-reimbursable.
administrative_procedures: Register online via Mobile JKN application, Pandawa WhatsApp (08118165165), or BPJS branch office.
Select and register one designated primary care clinic (FKTP) in neighborhood of residence.
Display digital KIS card in Mobile JKN application or present NIK KTP during medical check-in.
